incident-bot: Incident created • P1 • inference-latency-spike • paging maya (oncall) :rotating_light:

maya (oncall): seeing elevated p95 latency on hosted-api in us-west-2. Alerts page shows spike starting ~09:12. I’m taking lead, reassigning to kevin for infra checks.

kevin (sre): on it. checking node health and autoscaler logs. ETA 10m for initial triage.

sam (eng): FYI traffic pattern changed — a canary job started pushing longer context requests around 09:10. Could be batching/backpressure.

marta (comms): ping — prepping status page copy and customer outbound. Would like latest impact summary from oncall before I push anything.

maya (oncall): Current impact: elevated generation latency for ~12% of requests in us-west-2, p95 ~ 1.8s -> 4.6s, error rate stable. No data exfiltration. Affects hosted tier only.

kevin (sre): infra check: one GPU pool hit sustained high mem pressure, autoscaler scaled but with 2min lag. Couch logs show repeated model-quantize-worker restarts. Suspect recent model rollout variant with larger KV footprints.

sam (eng): rolling back the model canary now — triggering quick rollback to v3.2a.

ops-bot: Deploy action started by sam (eng) — rollback model canary to v3.2a (change-id: ch_4482).

marta (comms): Drafting internal incident comms snippets. Sharing proposed short and long forms for review.

marta (comms): Short status (for internal #all):
"We’re investigating increased inference latency for hosted API in us-west-2. Engineers are rolling back a recent model canary and autoscaling remains engaged. No user data exposure detected. We’ll post updates at :15 and :45 or as new info becomes available."

marta (comms): Longer update (for customer-facing status page / email):
"Summary: Between 09:10–09:40 UTC, some customers experienced higher-than-normal response times for text generation in the us-west-2 region. Impacted requests: ~10–15% of hosted API traffic. Root cause: a recent canary model variant increased memory usage and slowed autoscaler response. Mitigation: we rolled back the canary and scaled additional capacity; normal latency is returning. No customer data was accessed or modified. Next steps: post-incident RCA and follow-up mitigations (change to canary sizing and autoscaler tuning)."

marta (comms): Proposed placeholders and sections for our wording library (new format):
- incident_type: "latency spike" / "partial outage" / "error surge"
- affected_surface: "hosted API (us-west-2)"
- impact_scope: "% of requests, specific endpoints if known"
- user_action: "no action required" or "retry/backoff recommended"
- mitigation: short bullet of what we did
- rca_followup: timeline and next steps

marta (comms): Tone guidance: keep it concise, engineering-forward, avoid technical jargon in customer-facing messages, include what we know + what we don’t, and provide clear next steps. Use active voice.

kevin (sre): +1 to placeholders. Suggest adding a field: escalation_contact (oncall name + channel) for internal templates so support can loop in quickly.

maya (oncall): Also add "estimated-restoration" slot — even if it's an ETA or "under investigation", gives support something to quote.

sam (eng): rollback finished. ops-bot reports deployment success at 09:22. Latency trending down, p95 back to 1.9s in last 5m.

ops-bot: Deployment ch_4482 rollback complete — all instances healthy.

marta (comms): Updated customer copy suggestion with timing: "Mitigation completed at 09:22 UTC; metrics returning to normal. We'll keep monitoring and provide a full RCA within 72 hours."

maya (oncall): handing off to kevin for postmortem and RCA. I’ll update the oncall journal and include timeline.

kevin (sre): taking post-incident. Will add autoscaler tuning and canary memory limits to action items.

marta (comms): Final ask: approve the two outgoing messages (internal short + public status page). If no objections in 10m I’ll publish.

sam (eng): approve.

kevin (sre): approve.

maya (oncall): approve. Publish when ready. :thumbsup:

marta (comms): publishing now. I’ll attach the template IDs to the incident ticket: comms_template: INT-brief-v2 and STATUS-ambient-v1.2. Adding notes about tone + placeholders to the wording library repo.

incident-bot: Incident P1 (1798765432) status changed: mitigated -> monitoring.

marta (comms): follow-up: recommend we add a short "customer-facing technical appendix" stanza for sophisticated customers who want a bit more detail (one-paragraph RCA). Keep it optional and linked from the status page.

kevin (sre): agree. makes support life easier.

maya (oncall): closing the active paging loop. If anyone wants to add to the comms template PR, please comment on the repo by EOD.

marta (comms): thanks team. saving the final snippets into the internal incident comms library and tagging the change with #tone-adjust and #placeholders.

kevin (sre): logging post-incident actions to the ticket now.

maya (oncall): nice work.
